note: Roadmap F. Mechanical sentence patterns derived from the dissection: chunks from the token array, roles from the (particle, function_type) PAIR closing each chunk -- the pair, because から/case is an origin while から/conjunctive means 'porque', and の/case links nouns while の/nominalizer modifies nothing. は is TOPIC, not subject. に, で and と map to ni-phrase / de-phrase / to-phrase rather than guessing senses.
